fixes.change: Added splitSelfClosing(rest): a trailing '/' in the raw tag body is treated as the self-closing marker only when preceded by whitespace or a closing quote. Both firstBaseHref and extractHtml now use it instead of unconditionally stripping rest.endsWith('/'). Unquoted attribute values keep their final '/'; parseAttrs therefore sees '/sub/' and directoryBase preserves the directory for later links.

Reworked stringLiterals into a small tokenizer: lastToken tracking (property names after '.' are not keywords), a paren stack recording whether '(' followed if/while/for/with (condition) and whether it opens a for(...) header, postfix/prefix ++/-- that does not flip expectOperand, contextual 'of' only inside for headers, and the matching ')' of a condition sets expectOperand=true so a following '/' starts a regex literal.

tests_added: unquoted attribute keeps a trailing slash
postfix increment then division keeps later links
contextual keyword before division keeps later links
regex in statement position after if is not a link
notes: FIX 1 covers every unquoted attribute extractor because both tag scans now share splitSelfClosing; <base> was the only observable failure. FIX 2 also locks the reviewer-cited 'of / 2' and 'x.return / 2' regressions in the contextual-keyword test. Existing coverage stays green: basic 13, nested 6, attrs 5, css 4, flag 1, srcset cases, base first-wins, extractJs exact endpoints set and bundle set. Only lib/extract.js and tests/extract.test.js were modified.
